title: Who's at the Door, Grandma?

slices.alt: Comic, part 1 of 13: Verdict Picks Toon: Who's at the Door, Grandma? Caption: Grandma June's porch. Tuesday, 2:10 p.m.
Comic, part 2 of 13: Grandma June: Was someone at the door?
Comic, part 3 of 13: Jo: Grandma, let's get you a video doorbell.
Comic, part 4 of 13: Caption: The catch: many doorbells save video only if you pay for a plan.

Comic, part 7 of 13: Jo: $639.96 to watch Grandma's porch?!

Comic, part 9 of 13: Grandma June: Look at you, my little engineer.
Comic, part 10 of 13: Grandma June: I can see the whole porch!
Comic, part 11 of 13: Caption: The catch with every battery doorbell: at a busy door, owners get weeks of charge, not months. Jo: I'll charge it on Sundays, when I visit.
